semiconductor_relevance: High — Kenner Material & System Co., Ltd specializes in polymeric materials specifically designed for semiconductor packaging applications.
summary: Kenner Material & System Co., Ltd develops advanced polymeric materials for the semiconductor industry, focusing on electrically and thermally conductive sheets. Their products are tailored for applications in RF components, optical communication, and small form factor integrated circuits.
capabilities: Electrically conductive sheets for antistatic applications
Moisture barrier bags compliant with ANSI/ESD standards
Non-soldering adhesive surfaces for semiconductor packaging
